official_measurement_examples.name: 27 catchments calculators
official_measurement_examples.fact: Natural England calculator guidance covers nutrient-budget calculations for development in specified nutrient-neutrality catchments and was updated on 11 March 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Calculator is budget evidence
official_measurement_examples.fact: A calculator estimates the nutrient budget and mitigation requirement; it is not planning permission, a mitigation contract or proof that mitigation has been delivered.

official_measurement_examples.name: Credit scheme scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: Natural England sells nutrient mitigation credits in defined scheme catchments and eligibility depends on the development and catchment; a credit offer is not a universal England-wide entitlement.

official_measurement_examples.name: June 2026 current guidance
official_measurement_examples.fact: Natural England scheme guidance was updated 15 June 2026 and states developers can apply for credits while other mitigation options may also exist in relevant catchments.

official_measurement_examples.name: LPA decision role
official_measurement_examples.fact: Natural England advises and provides mitigation mechanisms, but local planning authorities make planning decisions; purchase of credits does not itself grant permission.

official_measurement_examples.name: Environmental permission separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Wetland or other mitigation projects can require environmental permits or licences in addition to planning considerations; nutrient mitigation does not replace those permissions.

official_measurement_examples.name: Habitats-law context
official_measurement_examples.fact: Nutrient neutrality is used to address effects on protected sites under habitats-law assessment; it must not be generalised as a universal nutrient rule for every parcel in England.

official_measurement_examples.name: Parcel limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Nutrient budget or credit status does not establish ownership wastewater connection capacity exact buildable area or final development yield.

core_rules: nutrient calculator output is not planning permission
calculator output is not delivered mitigation
credit application is not credit allocation
credit allocation is not planning permission
latest calculator version must be retained
Natural England advice is not parcel title evidence
wastewater capacity remains separate from nutrient budget
credit price or quantity does not calculate development yield
private and public mitigation routes must remain distinct
no parcel nutrient clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
mitigation must be secured and evidenced case-specifically
source_verification_note: Official Natural England, Defra, GOV.UK and legislation sources checked 2026-07-26. March-June 2026 calculator and scheme updates were retained with credit/planning, mitigation/delivery and environmental-permission separation; no parcel promotion.
